## Boundary and user impact

- [ ] OIDC
- [ ] Key Binding
- [ ] Enterprise Profile / branding
- [ ] Provider / model transport
- [ ] DSH client or native integration
- [ ] Build, dependency, or release
- [ ] Documentation only

## Security and compatibility

Describe identity, authorization, credential, SSRF/XSS, multi-user, protocol, and DSH-version implications.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Negative/failure tests added or not applicable
- [ ] Schema/OpenAPI/docs/changelog updated or not applicable
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, production endpoints, or unapproved brand assets
- [ ] New dependencies/licenses/install scripts disclosed or none
- [ ] Two reviewers requested for security-sensitive changes
